name: Tomato
stage_note: High N in vegetative stage; cut N and boost P/K at flower and fruit-set to avoid foliage-only growth
source: ICAR Tomato Package; UGA Extension Veg Guide

name: Spinach
stage_note: Nitrogen demand sustained throughout harvest; avoid excessive potassium to prevent salt stress
source: TNAU Agritech Spinach Portal; FAO Fertilizer Specs

name: Coriander
stage_note: Moderate vegetative nitrogen requirement; avoid high phosphorus early to retard premature bolting
source: ICAR Spices & Culinary Herbs; TNAU Portal

name: Green Chilli
stage_note: Moderate N during early canopy; restrict N during flowering; increase K during fruit maturation
source: ICAR Vegetable Guidelines; TNAU Agritech Chilli

name: Brinjal
stage_note: Heavy feeder; reduce N application at bud initiation; supply steady K throughout fruiting flushes

name: Rose
stage_note: Pruning flush requires balanced N; switch to elevated P and K upon bud swell for stem rigidity
source: Royal Horticultural Society Rose Care; ICAR Floriculture

name: Hibiscus
stage_note: Phosphorus sensitive; high P causes leaf chlorosis; requires high potassium for continual blooms

name: Marigold
stage_note: Excess nitrogen produces dense foliage with sparse flowering; maintain high P/K at flower bud stage
source: ICAR Floriculture Portal; TNAU Commercial Flowers

name: Holy Basil
stage_note: Lean fertility crop; pinch flower spikes to prolong vegetative leaf harvest; avoid fertilizer scorch
source: CIMAP Medicinal Plants Bulletin; TNAU Herbs

name: Garden Mint
stage_note: Frequent moisture and steady vegetative N promote tender runner leaves; cut back before flowering
source: CIMAP Aromatic Crop Guide; RHS Herbs

name: Money Plant
stage_note: Indoor foliage climber; modest nutritional demand; high nitrogen causes leggy petioles
source: UGA Extension Indoor Foliage Plants; RHS Houseplants

name: Carrot
stage_note: Root development prioritizes P and K; excess nitrogen induces root forking and hairy root defects
source: ICAR Tuber & Root Crops; FAO Vegetable Production

name: French Beans
stage_note: Symbiotic rhizobia fix atmospheric nitrogen; excess external N inhibits nodulation; focus on P/K
source: ICAR Pulse Guidelines; D1 Legume Cluster Reference

name: Dwarf Banana
stage_note: Heavy potassium consumer; transition to intensive K feeding at shooting and finger filling
source: NRC Banana Trichy; D1 Crop Recommendation Kaggle Centroid

name: Papaya
stage_note: Continuous bearer; balance N and K at onset of flowering; avoid waterlogging and root zone salt buildup
source: TNAU Horticulture Portal; D1 Crop Recommendation Kaggle Centroid
